posts.title: Watching AI write code changed how I review it
posts.description: Cold diffs are the worst way to review AI-written code. The agent's trajectory, which files it read, what it ran, how many retries, tells you where to actually look.

posts.title: Six AI agents, one codebase: what a normal day looks like now
posts.description: Lanes in the morning, checkpoint diffs at night. A day in the life of a codebase worked by several CLI agents in parallel, and the rules that keep it from turning into chaos.

posts.title: Managing AI coding agents is becoming a real job
posts.description: Less typing, more directing. The brief, delegate, inspect, unblock loop looks like management, and the skills that transfer are not the ones people expect.
